No tools or grading information are available. bindings are only exact public literals/typed primitive inputs with sources:[UNIT_IDS] provenance. A relation assembled from multiple factual lines must cite all of those units; bindings use the plural sources array, never a singular source field. booleans in bindings require a literal true/false in that unit. Integers, 0/1 and paragraph numbers are not truth values. Every year or other numeric binding must occur in its cited source units. Use observations for atomic FACTUAL predicates: entity must be an exact substring of a fact unit, predicate an exact substring of a rule unit. You do not provide their truth values. Observation and residual variable names MUST begin b_. Names carry no extra meaning: dates, years, quantifiers and comparisons must appear in the AST/typed inputs, never only in names. Reuse one observation for identical entity/predicate/source quotes; different names cannot add temporal context. Decompose legal applicability, arithmetic, thresholds, exceptions and conjunctions into nodes, never outsource the final claim, a complete legal rule or a numerical comparison to one observation. An observation can remain unknown when facts do not establish it; do not invent missing facts. For an unresolved legal/numerical SUBEXPRESSION use rule_residuals, with a Boolean b_ name, the rule source unit and an exact quote. It denotes both possible truth values and will NEVER be sent to the factual observer for resolution. A residual must be a proper, quoted subexpression inside an explicit clause value or source scope condition that reads it. This allows an external section reference or missing numeric comparison to remain unresolved without guessing its rule. Do not replace an entire untranslated clause or the final claim with one Boolean placeholder. nodes are local calculations with name/kind/body ONLY; they never discharge source coverage. Use scopes={name,source,condition} for each applicable source context or structural heading. The units contain every original nonblank source line exactly once. context lists compact dependency edges; inherited context is their transitive closure, never only the direct list. A scope owns exactly ONE public rule unit; its condition must be executable Boolean IR, never a string quoting the policy. Only a structural, nonconditional title may use literal true. A scope with unknown legal applicability may read a quoted Boolean rule_residual. Use clauses={name,sources,value,otherwise} for actual translated rule outputs. sources owns the actual rule units translated by this clause, not every heading it cites. The engine derives inherited scopes from the supplied source context and physically executes each clause as if(all inherited scopes, value, otherwise). You cannot omit an inherited guard. Choose an explicit disabled value (false,0,empty array,or null as appropriate); no value is guessed. All explicit conditional prefaces listed in required_scope_sources must be scopes, not quoted metadata. Unused scope declarations and local calculations do not cover source units. Translate other supplied rules into clauses/scopes even when not selected by this query; leave genuinely untranslated units unowned so they remain unknown-scope residuals. Do not mark a whole unparsed rule covered by citing a numeric constant or an unrelated node. For expressions use {var:NAME} or {op:OP,args:[...]}; if=[Boolean,then,else]. add/sub/min/max/lt/le use exact numbers, scale=[literal multiplier,numeric], divide_constant=[numeric,nonzero literal denominator]. and/or/not use Booleans. ceil_divide_constant=[numeric,positive literal denominator] is exact upward division for a source phrase such as each increment or fraction thereof; apply any statutory bounds explicitly. number_at=[numeric vector,nonnegative literal zero-based index] selects an actual numeric element, including an amount_values projection. An out-of-range access fails, with no default. Read different items from the one shared threaded amount_values node; do not re-consume its bank. A denominator 100 for a quoted percent and 2 for quoted one-half is an explicit unit conversion; it is not permission to invent those numbers as amounts or factual bindings. array creates arrays; object takes pair operations, each pair=[string key,value expression]. The root query combines guarded CLAUSE outputs and public inputs into the native result; it must not read local helper or scope names directly to bypass their enclosing clauses. Use named definitions to avoid duplicating ASTs. Do not return a constant native result. Connector nodes use the seven supplied typed operators or explicit available learned calls. When a supplied learned graph matches the actual role and column obligations, invoke its pattern hash/variant with complete slots/columns bindings; copying its operators independently is not library use. Never add an irrelevant call just to report reuse. All consumption of one allowance bank belongs in one threaded graph; never clone it. No other functions or hidden execution are available. All branches must type check. For SARA use Entailment/Contradiction; ProofWriter uses True/False/Unknown; Airline returns the full numeric cost; OpenExempt returns EC/EV with verbatim supplied citations; ContractNLI uses Entailment/Contradiction/NotMentioned. Source identifiers are metadata, not operands. Do not invent laws, entity witnesses, dates or constants. A quoted determination-time policy is not an executable temporal comparison. Use actual date/year operations when supported, and keep unsupported subexpressions residual. If previous_candidate is supplied, preserve its valid factual primitive names and quotes where their meaning is unchanged. Rewrite its incomplete rule/scoping representation into this contract; the previous candidate is not a trusted source or a grading answer. validation_feedback contains source-only compiler diagnostics, never target answers. Correct those specific errors by retranslating the public rules; do not coerce types, invent missing rules, or encode a clause identifier as its legal conclusion. format_only_example is an invented, unrelated task illustrating the complete syntax; its rules, source IDs, numbers and labels must not be copied into the CURRENT task. Compilation policy: answer_separating. Interface policy: collision_refined.
